en: Ok I am here.  Come buy my wares while the getting is good.  I mean I am giving you first crack at these.
Woohoo! They are into it now!
The Brotherhood will not be hampered by insects.
This will work -- keep heading through this gap.  The path to Un'Goro is due west of here once we round these infernal bugs.
HEY! No fair!
I must know something: How did you go to the bathroom with that thing on?
My apologies, I did not realize that you could understand what I was saying. What is it you are doing out here?
Good day, $gsir:ma'am;. I'd shake your hand, but as you see, I'm in the middle of something. May I be of assistance?

NEFARIAN IS SLAIN! People of Orgrimmar, bow down before the might of $n and $g his:her; allies for they have laid a blow against the Black Dragonflight that is sure to stir the Aspects from their malaise! This defeat shall surely be felt by the father of the Black Flight: Deathwing reels in pain and anguish this day!
Where is Elder Dawnstrider?
Notify me when you are ready to listen to the story.
Why don't we deal with you now, Hendel? Lady Proudmoore will speak to you back in the tower.
So, the frail members of the living have some teeth after all. Take this place, then, for the time being. We will return, twice as strong, and your paltry forces will fall!
It's in the hole!  It's in the hole!
You dare!  Outrageous!  I curse you, $c.  I curse you with... death!
I'm sure it's just incompetence or oversight by some of the workers.
We haveone quarter of the needed silithyst! Keep it up!
%s feeds the squirrel some of the viscous fluid.

So you think you are good enough to learn from me? The great Snarl? You are no more than a lowly worm beneath my boot. However, taking on an underling might make me seem more appealing to Sumi and Tumi. Let's see what meager skills you possess.
Leave this place. <The relic emits a white hot arc of flame. A memory has been gained: A lone Dark Iron dwarf is surrounded by seven corpses, kneeling before a monolith of flame.>
You are not ready. Speak to Betty Quinn, she's standing by the stairs over there. Return to me when you have achieved a higher enlightenment.
We don't have many supplies for rebuilding.  It will take a lot more before Dun Baldar will be repaired.

I hear that they have a Mining Trainer in Thunder Bluff to the north.  Take the road out of the village and when you get there ride the elevator to the top of the rise.  Any of the Bluffwatchers should be able to help you from there.
Listen, young $c.  You hear the call of water?
I... am... released... perhaps it's not too late to- No! I need... more... time...
Greetings, noble $c.  This humble servant of the Cenarion Circle wishes blessings and bounties be given unto you and yours.
I am ready to hear your tale, Tirion.
Senior Wing Commander Vipore, launching. Pray for a swift death, Frostwolf.
When Lolo doesn't wanna spill any o' his precious ale or get his lil' dress dirty, I'm called in. Yep. Ol' Hansel is the dwarf they use to mete out a lil' bit o' justice an' a whole lotta pain.
If you wait to come see me, there may be nothing left!

Nefarian had ordered that unsuitable subjects be destroyed immediately, but these retched beasts would not do so without first inflicting an 'ample' amount of torture.$B$BWhen we were thoroughly 'broken,' they would round up what remained and throw us to these thugs. Our bodies used as instruments in their sick game: thrown into the lava or worse; to the open and waiting arms of the bloodthirsty legion below.
I'd like some weapon training
You are looking for Uthan Stillwater.  You will find him west of the village, fishing at Stonebull Lake.
Psssst.  We just got some Moonshine in. . . .
As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

Please, help me $g brother : sister;...$B$BI will soon pass from this world, and though I suffer I know I shall not any more once I pass.  The wildlife though, my $g brother : sister;... the wildlife suffers too, and it knows no release.  I ask for your aid with my last breaths of life.
Um, you kill king, yeah?  That means you take his place.  That make you da new boss!  Hail to da king!
